snippet.title: Dancing Eyes (PS3 - Cancelled)
snippet.description:
Part of the Namco Generations series for PS3 which had the goal to remake old Namco arcade games like Pac Man or Galaga to release through Playstation Network, Dancing Eyes was announced by the publisher in 2011.
The original source material was a puzzle game for the arcades released in 1996 in which you had to strip down idols with the help of a little monkey.
The new PS3 game supported the peripheral Playstation Move probably to let the player feel more in touch with the young idols.

In April 2012 Namco officially announced that the development on the project was terminated.

Original official site with more images:
http://ng.namco-ch.net/dancingeyes/index.html
